summary: A three-masted sailing warship in the galleon style: a lofted round-bilged hull with tumblehome, a black wale… joints rudder, ships_wheel, guns_l, gunport_l0, gunport_l1, gunport_l2, …; options hull_paint, sails, flag; sockets seat_driver, eye_point, waterline, socket_crows_nest, socket_deck, socket_bow, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.pirate_galleon or place "prefab": "pirate_galleon" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
